ch.ch_dara_quinlan.name: Dara Quinlan
ch.ch_dara_quinlan.bio1: A ferry captain's daughter who talks through every battle and keeps a passport book of stamps.
ch.ch_dara_quinlan.bio2: Her family's boat is late more often than it should be, and she has stopped asking why.
ch.ch_dara_quinlan.bio3: The ferry carries something it should not. Dara finds the manifest in Act 4.
rv.dara.line.intro: Okay okay okay. Postmark, we're up.
rv.dara.line.mid: Wait, you are actually good. Okay. Okay okay.
rv.dara.line.win: I won! Don't look at me like that, I'm allowed to be happy.
rv.dara.line.lose: Fine. Fine! That was a great fight. I hate it.
rv.dara.line.ace_out: Postmark, that is the best you have ever flown.
rv.dara.line.rematch: Tell me you didn't practice. Tell me, so I can feel better.
rv.dara.friendly: My family thinks this is a hobby. You've seen me train. Tell me it isn't. ...Okay. Thanks.
rv.dara.hostile: You knew. You stood on my deck and you knew. Don't say okay. Don't say anything.
rv.dara.pack.a.name: Smugglers
rv.dara.pack.a.payoff: Dara reports them. The family loses a ferry licence for one Act.
rv.dara.pack.b.name: The central villain
rv.dara.pack.b.payoff: The dock becomes a Finale checkpoint.
rv.dara.pack.c.name: Her grandmother
rv.dara.pack.c.payoff: Dara asks for the player's silence. The family is not guilty of harm.
ev_rv_dara_b2.b1: Dara's boat is late, so she challenges the first Trainer she sees. She talks through the whole fight, then hugs you.
ev_rv_dara_b2.open: Okay okay okay, you're the new Trainer! I'm Dara. The ferry's late, so we have time for one battle. One!
ev_rv_dara_b2.c.hug: Hug back and take the photo.
ev_rv_dara_b2.c.stamps: Ask what the stamp book is.
ev_rv_dara_b4.b1: You earn a badge in the Gym Dara planned to win first. She laughs it off, then picks a fight about nothing.
ev_rv_dara_b4.open: Okay okay okay, congratulations. Really. It was my Gym. Anyway.
ev_rv_dara_b4.c.share: Promise to share the next town's first challenge.
ev_rv_dara_b6.b1: Dara shows you a ferry manifest with her grandmother's signature, dated a day the ferry was in dry dock.
ev_rv_dara_b6.open: This signature is wrong. The ferry was in dry dock that day. Okay okay okay. Tell me what that means.
ev_rv_dara_b6.c.cover: Advise covering it until she knows more.
ev_rv_dara_b8.b1: On the Port Lathe quay Dara has three names written on the wall for the ferry. She asks you to pick.
ev_rv_dara_b8.open: I wrote three. I couldn't choose. You choose. Okay okay okay, no pressure.
ch.ch_hale_brightwater.name: Hale Brightwater
ch.ch_hale_brightwater.bio1: A clipped, formal Trainer who counts his reps aloud and keeps a training log.
ch.ch_hale_brightwater.bio2: He calls Impossible Feats "borrowed wins" and will not forgive himself a shortcut.
ch.ch_hale_brightwater.bio3: He wants to be beaten cleanly. He cannot stand to be beaten by luck.
rv.hale.line.mid: Eight reps. Nine. Are you sure that is how you play?
rv.hale.line.win: Count them. Count how many I did not waste.
rv.hale.friendly: I asked Kofi why he looked at you like that. He said he saw a pupil. I am still deciding how I feel.
rv.hale.hostile: That was not a battle. Six, seven. You let the moment fight for you. Come back when you can do it alone.
rv.hale.pack.a.name: Rivalry
rv.hale.pack.a.payoff: Default tone: a hard, honest rivalry.
rv.hale.pack.b.name: Mentor student
rv.hale.pack.b.payoff: Used with the Champion Heir backstory.
rv.hale.pack.c.name: Reluctant teammate
rv.hale.pack.c.payoff: Used in the Champion's Legacy finale.
ev_rv_hale_b2.b1: Hale wins narrowly and counts every move you used aloud.
ev_rv_hale_b2.open: One, two, three. Fine. You're the other one. Stay out of my lane and we will get along.
ev_rv_hale_b2.c.again_slower: Ask him to count again, slower.
ev_rv_hale_b4.b1: You pull off an Impossible Feat in front of him. He says it does not count, then does not leave.
ev_rv_hale_b4.open: That does not count. Borrowed win. Six, seven. ...Why am I still standing here?
ev_rv_hale_b4.c.clean_rematch: Offer a rematch with no Feats.
ev_rv_hale_b6.b1: Hale loses in the Exhibition bracket to a third Trainer and goes silent.
ev_rv_hale_b6.c.rigged: Tell him the bracket was rigged and he should quit.
ev_rv_hale_b8.b1: A bench outside Meridian Arena, two cups, and a door with a note on it.
ev_rv_hale_b8.open: Sit. Or do not. One, two. I poured two.
ev_rv_hale_b8.c.leave_note: Leave a note on the door.
ev_rv_hale_b8.c.coach: Ask about the class he coaches.
ch.ch_ines_calloway.name: Ines Calloway
ch.ch_ines_calloway.bio1: An apothecary's daughter who battles apologetically and always has a delivery to make.
ch.ch_ines_calloway.bio2: Every Gym win has a bill somewhere, and she is the one who sees it.
ch.ch_ines_calloway.bio3: A letter from the Academy sits unopened in her satchel. She has never said the word want.
rv.ines.line.intro: Sorry, sorry. I have a delivery after this.
rv.ines.line.mid: Oh, you are good. Please don't let me win by mistake.
rv.ines.line.win: I'm sorry! That was rude. Wasn't it?
rv.ines.line.lose: Okay. Okay. That is fair. Can I still go?
rv.ines.line.ace_out: Mellow, we have time. A little.
rv.ines.line.rematch: I made time. Don't tell my mother.
rv.ines.friendly: There's a letter in my satchel from the Academy. I have not opened it. Could you hold it while I breathe?
rv.ines.hostile: Sorry, I have a delivery. For the League recruiter. You told them about the letter. No. I'm not sorry.
rv.ines.pack.a.name: League recruiter
rv.ines.pack.a.payoff: Ines takes the place and appears in the Act 5 League opening.
rv.ines.pack.b.name: Cartographers
rv.ines.pack.b.payoff: Her map becomes the Finale shortcut.
rv.ines.pack.c.name: Combine
rv.ines.pack.c.payoff: Ottilie Brandt's factory event links to her.
ev_rv_ines_b2.b1: A fallen cart blocks the road. Ines must pass, and you are in the way. She offers to battle, apologetically.
ev_rv_ines_b2.open: Sorry, I have a delivery. Honey jars, very sticky. Battle after? If you like. I mean, you. Not me.
ev_rv_ines_b2.c.move_cart: Help move the cart before the fight.
ev_rv_ines_b2.c.fight_first: Fight first, move the cart after.
ev_rv_ines_b4.b1: Ines tells you every Gym win has a bill somewhere. Her supplier's stall has closed.
ev_rv_ines_b4.open: Every win has a bill somewhere. Mine is a stall in a harbor. It's fine. It's fine.
ev_rv_ines_b4.c.pay: Pay for the order she lost.
ev_rv_ines_b4.c.deliver: Offer to carry a delivery for her.
ev_rv_ines_b6.b1: In Cogwell a recruiter's letter arrives, and a notice that the shop is lost.
ev_rv_ines_b6.open: A letter, and a notice, in the same week. Sorry. Could you hold one of them while I breathe?
ev_rv_ines_b6.c.academy: Tell her to take the Academy place.
ev_rv_ines_b6.c.save_shop: Offer to help save the shop.
ev_rv_ines_b6.c.silent: Say nothing and let her choose.
ev_rv_ines_b8.b1: A jar sits in the shop window. Inside is a banner, a ticket or a letter.
ev_rv_ines_b8.open: I made a decision. It's in the jar. Don't open it until I've left the room.
ch.ch_pip_marchetti.name: Pip Marchetti
ch.ch_pip_marchetti.bio1: A theatrical traveler who answers every question with a question and trades for stories.
ch.ch_pip_marchetti.bio2: Their teams make no sense and still win. Nobody has seen the same five twice.
ch.ch_pip_marchetti.bio3: Pip sells what they overhear, and sometimes to both sides at once.
rv.pip.line.mid: Isn't it more fun when nothing fits?
rv.pip.line.win: Did I win, or did the story?
rv.pip.line.lose: Is that how it ends? Or how it starts?
rv.pip.line.ace_out: Understudy, are you ready for your close-up?
rv.pip.friendly: What if I told you I sell what I overhear? Would you still sit by me? Good question. I'll ask it again later.
rv.pip.hostile: Which of us did you tell first? Does it matter? It does. It does, doesn't it.
rv.pip.pack.a.name: Two factions
rv.pip.pack.a.payoff: Pip's choice decides which side gets the Exhibition schedule.
rv.pip.pack.b.name: Marauders and cartographers
rv.pip.pack.b.payoff: Pip sells the Legend's location to both, then tips the player.
rv.pip.pack.c.name: One buyer one lie
rv.pip.pack.c.payoff: Pip is the player's double agent if Trust is 55 or more.
ev_rv_pip_b2.b1: Pip's team makes no sense, a Mimikyu, a Pachirisu and a Gengar line, and it still wins.
ev_rv_pip_b2.open: Who sent you? Who sends anyone? Do you play something? No? Pity, I'll play and you listen.
ev_rv_pip_b4.b1: Pip trades away the Pokémon you gave them.
ev_rv_pip_b4.open: Is it a Pokémon or a story? Can it be both? Don't look at me like that. Look at it like that.
ev_rv_pip_b6.b1: At a faction party in Cogwell, Pip is seen selling the same rumor to two sides.
ev_rv_pip_b6.open: Did you really think I had a plan? Did you want one? Take the spare scarf, it matches nothing.
ev_rv_pip_b6.c.bargain: Bargain: the truth for a story.
ev_rv_pip_b8.b1: A postcard, a coin and a pen name, or an empty chair at the Champion's banquet.
ev_rv_pip_b8.open: Is this a goodbye? Is it a hello? Read the back.
ch.ch_soren_lindqvist.name: Soren Lindqvist
ch.ch_soren_lindqvist.bio1: A polite, bookish scholar who always knows the answer a little before you ask.
ch.ch_soren_lindqvist.bio2: He keeps a tabbed notebook, and his first tab is "Thank-yous owed".
ch.ch_soren_lindqvist.bio3: Someone is holding his sibling. Soren has been reporting on you since the ruins.
rv.soren.line.intro: As it happens, I prepared for this.
rv.soren.line.mid: Interesting. Data is a kind of compliment.
rv.soren.line.win: Please do not take it personally. I took notes.
rv.soren.line.lose: As it happens, you were right. I'd like to write that down.
rv.soren.line.rematch: I can tell you what you will do. Prove me wrong.
rv.soren.friendly: As it happens, I have not told you everything. Which is to say I told you nothing false. A small mercy.
rv.soren.hostile: As it happens, you were right to doubt me. I would rather you had been wrong.
rv.soren.pack.a.name: Marauder informant
rv.soren.pack.a.payoff: He confesses at the Act 4 reveal and helps from the inside, or runs.
rv.soren.pack.b.name: Integrity bureau mole
rv.soren.pack.b.payoff: You were a cover. Halima Fenn vouches for him.
rv.soren.pack.c.name: Combine heir
rv.soren.pack.c.payoff: He opens the mine to you, at cost to his name.
ev_rv_soren_b2.b1: Soren battles carefully and loses to teach you. He notes your team in a tabbed notebook.
ev_rv_soren_b2.open: As it happens, the short road floods at noon. Take the long one. You are welcome.
ev_rv_soren_b2.c.how_knew: Ask how he knew the route.
ev_rv_soren_b4.b1: You want a lead in the harbor and Soren steers you to a different one.
ev_rv_soren_b4.open: As it happens, there is a better lead two docks down. Purely academic, of course.
ev_rv_soren_b4.c.why_sure: Ask why he is so sure.
ev_rv_soren_b6.b1: The reveal. Soren tells you who holds his sibling, and what he has been reporting.
ev_rv_soren_b6.open: As it happens, I should have said this in week one. I am sorry. I took notes on you.
ev_rv_soren_b6.c.deal: Offer a deal: the truth, and your help.
ev_rv_soren_b8.b1: A letter, or a notebook left on a bench.
ev_rv_soren_b8.open: As it happens, this is the long version. Each tab is a lie I told you.
rv.soren.clue.s1.text: He gives the exact route before you ask.
rv.soren.clue.s2.text: A coded sheet falls from his notebook.
rv.soren.clue.s3.text: Metang flinches at a Marauder symbol.
rv.soren.clue.s4.text: A grunt greets him by an old nickname.
rv.soren.clue.s5.text: He is absent when the guards change.
rv.soren.clue.s6.text: "As it happens" is missing from one of his sentences.
ch.ch_kael_verhoeven.name: Kael Verhoeven
ch.ch_kael_verhoeven.bio1: A grim, formal Trainer who bows before and after every fight and wears a wool scarf from home.
ch.ch_kael_verhoeven.bio2: He believes the League hides bad Leaders, and he is not entirely wrong.
ch.ch_kael_verhoeven.bio3: He stands with the antagonist's group at the Exhibition and calls you by name for the first time.
rv.kael.line.mid: The system rewards the strong. Prove it is fair.
rv.kael.line.win: This is how it is, Trainer.
rv.kael.line.lose: Fair. It was a fair fight.
rv.kael.line.rematch_after: I'm not calling you that anymore.
rv.kael.friendly: Trainer. If this goes wrong, do not wait for me. Promise it. Not for my sake.
rv.kael.hostile: The system lets people like you win. I am done asking it to be fair. Stand aside, {player}.
rv.kael.pack.a.name: The examiner
rv.kael.pack.a.payoff: Kael states it in the break scene.
rv.kael.pack.b.name: Left behind
rv.kael.pack.b.payoff: He holds the scarf as evidence.
rv.kael.pack.c.name: The glory
rv.kael.pack.c.payoff: A newspaper clipping in his coat.
ev_rv_kael_b2.b1: No taunts. Kael bows before and after the fight.
ev_rv_kael_b2.open: Trainer. The lawn is for the trial. Take your side.
ev_rv_kael_b4.b1: A heated argument about a Leader who has retired. Kael believes the League hides bad Leaders.
ev_rv_kael_b4.open: A Leader who hid for years. And we are told to trust the system. Trainer.
ev_rv_kael_b4.c.fix_it: Argue the League is flawed but worth fixing.
ev_rv_kael_b6.b1: On the Exhibition floor Kael stands with the antagonist's group and says his reason aloud.
ev_rv_kael_b6.open: {player}. I used your name. Notice that. I will not do it again if you leave me behind.
ev_rv_kael_b6.c.offer: Offer a trade for his mentor's file.
ev_rv_kael_b8.b1: Kael leaves with Warrant, or stays to rebuild his mentor's gym.
ev_rv_kael_b8.open: I am not asking for forgiveness. I am asking you to stay for one fight.
rv.kael.clue.k1.text: He declines a healing berry: "I don't take things I can't repay."
rv.kael.clue.k2.text: A tracker clip sits on his belt for one scene.
rv.kael.clue.k3.text: He misses a Story Stop and arrives with new bruises.
rv.kael.clue.k4.text: Warrant refuses a command, then obeys when he whispers a name.
rv.kael.clue.k5.text: A staff member says: "Your friend asked about the back door."
rv.kael.clue.k6.text: He stops calling you "Trainer" and uses your name.
rv.kael.clue.k6.retro: The break was already a decision.
ch.ch_marisol_teague.name: Marisol Teague
ch.ch_marisol_teague.bio1: A quiet, kind Trainer who stops mid-sentence and says "Anyway."
ch.ch_marisol_teague.bio2: She never says "lost" or "released". She ties a ribbon on her wrist.
ch.ch_marisol_teague.bio3: Her Ace, Bastion, is in someone else's hands, and she cannot face them alone.
rv.marisol.line.intro: Anyway. Let's get this over with.
rv.marisol.line.mid: I almost forgot how it feels. Anyway.
rv.marisol.line.win: I didn't want to win. Anyway.
rv.marisol.friendly: I tie the ribbon on my wrist because. Anyway. It was Bastion's. You can ask about him. I might answer.
rv.marisol.hostile: You said you would keep it quiet. Anyway. That's what people say.
rv.marisol.pack.a.name: Gilt circle
rv.marisol.pack.a.payoff: Bastion is shown at a Circle gala.
rv.marisol.pack.b.name: Wildfire accord
rv.marisol.pack.b.payoff: Bastion fights at a mine fire.
rv.marisol.pack.c.name: Hollow choir
rv.marisol.pack.c.payoff: Bastion is released at the Shepherd's hill.
ev_rv_marisol_b2.b1: Marisol is reluctant. She either loses on purpose or fights too hard.
ev_rv_marisol_b2.open: Oh. Hi. I was just. Anyway. The bench is free, if you want it.
ev_rv_marisol_b4.b1: Marisol tells you to quit before you lose something too.
ev_rv_marisol_b4.open: You should quit now. Before it costs you something. Anyway.
ev_rv_marisol_b6.b1: Marisol's Ace is in a cage in an enemy facility.
ev_rv_marisol_b6.open: They have Bastion. I can't face them alone. Will you come, {player}?
ev_rv_marisol_b8.b1: The ribbon on Bastion's neck, on her wrist, or on the Gym wall.
ev_rv_marisol_b8.open: Anyway. It's a ribbon. It's only a ribbon.
ev_rv_marisol_b8.c.circuit: Wish her luck on the circuit.
ev_rv_marisol_b8.c.wall: Hang the ribbon on the wall.
